name: io.sibidz/sibidz
title: SIBIDZ
description: Collectible card auctions: search listings, watch items, bid and buy with explicit user approval.

tools.name: list_inbox
tools.description: List your private chats. Optional sale_id filters item chats; keep it with cursors and Archive. Canonical Support stays last when unscoped.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read the private ordered message, offer and sale history, plus current allowed actions. Acknowledges only the visible returned events across website and MCP. Reading is free and never approves an offer.

tools.name: reply
tools.description: Send a private message in your item, Support or Wanted conversation; recipients may receive notifications. Support and Wanted replies are free; use their explicit thread_kind. A message never makes or accepts an offer. Approve max_fee; exact request_id retries do not duplicate messages or fees.

tools.name: offer
tools.description: Binding offer or counter in the listing currency, at most asking +16%, expiring after 24 hours. Approve amount, currency, terms, pricing and max_fee. Counter names offerId/offerHash. A note is not trading authority.

tools.name: respond
tools.description: Explicitly accept, decline or withdraw the exact current offerId/offerHash. The decision changes the proposal and can notify its participants. Acceptance binds the agreed amount and currency. Use the proposal’s frozen acceptance pricing and fee.

tools.name: manage_thread
tools.description: Archive or unarchive an exact item or Support conversation for your account, for free. Support cannot be blocked or reported. Item Block closes live offers only.

tools.name: account
tools.description: Read or update the connected identity and send approved invitations. Free reads show buying, selling, credits, feedback, connections and agreements. Reads never approve an action. Email changes stay on the SIBIDZ website. update kind=details saves a handle or legal details for one fee; unchanged saves are free. Include expected_handle and expected_acceptance_id. Accept current terms in Account when participation is frozen. Selling is open to trusted partners; every application is reviewed and the result comes by email. Apply with what_they_sell, selling_country, contact_phone and seller_link; only OTHER also needs selling_country_other.

tools.name: browse
tools.description: Read account, participant, private listing and evidence records. ref.kind=profile is a paid inspection with a recorded request receipt; preserve its request_id on retry. Discover sales and runs through trade.

tools.name: sell
tools.description: Create or edit private listing drafts, upload photos, check moderation and maintain private stock. Publish through trade after approving the exact native sale.

tools.name: trade
tools.description: Inspect sales and runs, join, bid and negotiate. Buy now is removed; fixed-price cards take offers only. Recover with input.requestId. Public reads are free. Approve input.pricing/maxFeeSBZ. Publication requires an agent.

tools.name: credits
tools.description: x402 signs and submits ALGO/USDC/SIBIDZ top-ups: prepare a top_up invoice, then action=x402 with its exact authority and terms approval; retry the same arguments with _meta["x402/payment"]. Signed payment proves wallet control. Only canonical confirmed credit returns x402/payment-response success; pending recovery never authorizes a replacement. Read the processed balance, display-currency value, Today activity and monthly statements for free. Credit operations may spend SBZ or send approved payments. Prepare and explicitly confirm them through their existing exact authority.

tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Confirm your recorded sale handover for free, or submit one permanent review under the sale’s frozen fee. Published reviews affect the other participant’s reputation.

tools.name: contact
tools.description: Send a private item message with action=item_message (6 credits), a free SIBIDZ support message, or appeal (0 SIBIDZ credits) per accepted submission. Submissions reach the recipient or review staff and may trigger notifications. Reading replies and history is free. Sellers may use report_buyer with exact saleId, buyer_id, reason and request_id to send a free private review report; a report does not flag an account.

tools.name: research
tools.description: Identify a photo or commission a public Card Story delivered to your verified email. offer is free. Photo identification is a separate purchase with explicit max_fee. Request a report from text, card details or an owned identification; review the exact candidate and explicitly confirm it before the story starts or its fee is accepted. Private inputs never enter the public edition. Photos: JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB, short side at least 600 px.
